dek: Dueling commmemorations of the 823 Artillery Bombardment took place yesterday in Kinmen. 823 refers to the Chinese attack on Kinmen that started the Second Taiwan Strait Crisis. In many ways, between the commemorations held by KMT and DPP, the two commemorations were much more about life today
